event_station_013@node_spine_2.quirk: Their head tilts with slow precision, like a dial being set.

shipLog.text: ◆ Arriving at station. MARV notes this is where you find out what the journey has cost you. Financially. He means financially.
◆ Seedlings in the growbay. MARV has calculated their survival odds. He is keeping the number to himself. Starting optimism is a resource.
Arrived: Nebula 1. The leg cost −3 FUEL, +2 MORALE, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
Departure Protocol. The captain chose “Check the crop one last time before departure”. Noted.
The crop is fine. +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. It will not last.
Arrived: Crossroads (The Space Version). The leg cost −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, +2 MORALE, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
The Half-Built Relay. The captain chose “Give them the time”. Noted.
Your ship holds the girder steady while their welders walk the seam. +5 FUEL, +4 MORALE, 4 DAYS. It will not last.
Market Row. The captain chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Noted.
1 DAY. It will not last.
Station Inbound. The captain chose “LEAVE STATION”. Noted.
Nothing aboard changed. It will not last.
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ Station approach. Life support here is maintained by the lowest bidder. MARV has met the lowest bidder. He would like to be undocked by evening.
Arrived: Asteroid Field 3. The leg cost −3 FUEL, +2 MORALE, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
A Word, Captain. The captain chose “"We share it. Always."”. Noted.
Reeves exhales. +3 MORALE, 1 DAY. It will not last.
◆ We departed Earth orbit with every item technically fine. I have been watching ‘technically’ erode ever since.
Tomato: VEGETATIVE. 29% grown, health 90. Temporarily.
◆ MINE — recovered 4 minerals, 7 metal, 5 scrap, 1 exotic, ice melted for +9 water.
Arrived: Kepler-78b (Provisional). The leg cost −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, +2 MORALE, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
The Claim Boards. The captain chose “File a modest claim of your own — 5 gold”. Noted.
Five gold files a homestead marker on an unremarkable patch of… +4 MORALE, −5 GOLD, 1 DAY. It will not last.
◆ MARV has finished recalculating the route. The result is the same route. He does this to feel something.
▶ TRADER SHIP ON APPROACH
Arrived: FSS Due Diligence. The leg cost −3 FUEL, +2 MORALE, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
Lockdown. The captain chose “Blow the door from outside”. Noted.
You line the ship up and fire the docking thrusters into the… −6 HULL, −3 FUEL, 1 DAY. As calculated.
◆ Approaching the derelict. Once, someone looked at this ship the way you look at ours. MARV mentions this only because nobody else will.
Tomato: FLOWERING. 52% grown, health 99. Temporarily.
Arrived: Site B (Site A Is Classified). The leg cost −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, +2 MORALE, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (2/3). The colony office will want this.
◆ MARV appends the reading: keeping a drive alive far from any shipyard is half of what spaceflight is.
Engine Fault. The captain chose “Limp mode: half power the rest of the way”. Noted.
You drop the drive to half power and leave the fault where it is. −2 FUEL, −1 MORALE, 2 DAYS. As calculated.
◆ We still own a dot on Mars. It will outlast everyone aboard. I find that comforting, which tells you something about my other comforts.
Arrived: Route Decision. The leg cost −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, −5 CROP, +2 MORALE, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
◆ The ship computer notes that more events have been logged about the tomatoes than about the hull. It does not editorialize. (−5 crop health)
The Buoy With Opinions. The captain chose “Port lane — long but honest”. Noted.
You take the honest lane. 1 DAY. It will not last.
Tomato: MATURING. 77% grown, health 100. Temporarily.
◆ Maturity reached. MARV has reclassified the crop from 'investment' to 'asset at risk.' Every asset is at risk. This one is simply worth more now.
◆ The ship computer notes tomatoes have real flight heritage: grown aboard the ISS in the Veggie experiment.
